eradication.description: ERADICATION is a team shooter in which contractors recover territory from the Furries.
eradication.pageDescription: ERADICATION is a free team shooter on Roblox by Low Quality Interactive. Contractors recover a town from the Furries.
eradication.pageLead: Contractors fight the Furries and recover six territories.
eradication.faqWhatIs: ERADICATION is a team shooter on Roblox. The player is a contractor who must recover a town from the Furries.
eradication.faqHowToPlay: The map has seven flags. Recover the six Furry flags to open the tunnel. Keep away from a dead Pimple Furry.

donpollo-obby.description: DON POLLO OBBY is a short obstacle course with low-difficulty stages.
donpollo-obby.pageDescription: DON POLLO OBBY is a Roblox obstacle course by Low Quality Interactive. The game is in sunset status but remains available.
donpollo-obby.pageLead: The game has short stages, fast restarts, and speedrun routes.
donpollo-obby.artworkAlt: Don Pollo Obby floating course artwork
donpollo-obby.faqWhatIs: DON POLLO OBBY is a short obstacle course on Roblox. The game is in sunset status, but players can still use it.

favela-94.description: Favela '94 is a tactical shooter that takes place in a Brazilian favela in 1994.
favela-94.pageDescription: Favela '94 is a tactical Roblox shooter by Low Quality Interactive. The game takes place in Rio de Janeiro in 1994.
favela-94.pageLead: The map has narrow alleys, accessible rooftops, and short-range combat.
favela-94.artworkAlt: Favela '94 cover art - armed operators in a 1994 Rio favela alley
favela-94.faqWhatIs: Favela '94 is a tactical shooter on Roblox. The game has short rounds and takes place in Rio de Janeiro in 1994.
favela-94.faqHowToPlay: Select a loadout. Use the alleys and rooftops to move through the map. Change position after an enemy sees you.
